'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war]], [[United Arab Emirates in the 2026 Iran war]], [[United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[2026 United States–Ukraine–Russia meetings in Abu Dhabi]]
****A third round of [[United States]]-mediated talks between [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] and [[Russia|Russian]] delegations begins in [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]], focusing on [[Humanitarian impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|the humanitarian impact of the war]], [[Prisoners of war in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|prisoners of war]], and security guarantees. Earlier in the day, the American and Ukrainian teams held a separate meeting with representatives of [[France]], [[Germany]], [[Italy]], the [[United Kingdom]], the [[European Commission]], and [[NATO]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-putin-zelenskyy-uae-3d878a3e56d5df5bd198a6d20c824d18 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/us-russia-and-ukraine-start-talks-in-abu-dhabi/live-79906232 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/10/us-officials-russia-ukraine-war-abu-dhabi-talks (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]], [[Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**The [[Court-martial|military court]] in [[Goma]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], sentences 66 [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|soldiers]] to death on charges of cowardice, [[mutiny]], and failure to obey orders, after they were arrested following clashes with [[Front for the Refoundation of the Nation]] rebels. [https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-66-soldiers-sentenced-to-death-for-cowardice-in-conflict-with-frn-rebels/a-79906794 (DW)]
*[[Terrorism in Kenya]], [[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Eight people, including five workers and two [[Kenya Police|police reservists]], are killed by suspected [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militants in [[Mandera County]], [[Kenya]], near the border with [[Somalia]], during an [[ambush]] against a vehicle. [https://aa.com.tr/en/africa/suspected-al-shabaab-militants-kill-8-in-northeastern-kenya-ambush/4119429 (AFP via AA)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/eight-people-killed-kenyas-northeast-suspected-al-shabaab-attack-2026-11-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Energy crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[Venezuela]]n [[National Assembly of Venezuela|National Assembly]] unanimously approves a reform of the [[Energy policy of Venezuela|electricity law]] which allows [[private companies]] and [[joint venture]]s to invest in the [[nationalised]] [[Electricity sector in Venezuela|electricity sector]], which [[Government of Venezuela|the government]] has controlled since 2007. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20261111-venezuela-opens-electricity-sector-to-private-investment (AFP via RFI)]
*The [[Monetary Authority of Singapore|Monetary Authority]] of [[Singapore]] launches a [[gold reserve]] service for foreign [[central bank]]s, [[international financial institutions]], and [[sovereign entities]], and announces expanded [[tax exemption]]s for [[wholesale]] gold services. [https://www.thedailystar.net/business/global-economy/news/singapore-launches-gold-storage-service-central-banks-4319921 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/singapore-launch-gold-vault-service-foreign-central-banks-2026-11-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eleven people are killed and at least 51 others are seriously injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] involving over 80 trucks and cars on the [[Trakia motorway|Trakia A1 motorway]] near [[Yambol]], [[Bulgaria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/10/at-least-12-people-killed-in-motorway-crash-in-southeastern-bulgaria (Al Jazeera)]
*Five schoolgirls are killed and 21 others are injured when a school bus plunges into a [[pond]] in [[Kandal province]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cambodia-traffic-accidents-school-bus-e0c3e6316356dcbe3c4ff9fbed68a62b (AP)]
*Three people are killed and three others injured after a vehicle crashes into a crowd of pedestrians and food vendors on a sidewalk near the [[North Hollywood station |North Hollywood Metro station]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/la-car-crash-north-hollywood.html (New York Times)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Thailand|Thai]] [[Cabinet of Thailand|cabinet]] approves new [[Environmental issues in Thailand|environmental regulations]] for [[data center]]s, including limits on noise and temperature increases, [[Waste management in Thailand|requirements]] for [[Water cooling|cooling-water]] [[Reclaimed water|recycling]] and [[Water testing|testing]], and [[industrial zoning]] for facilities consuming more than 20 megawatts. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/thailand-sets-noise-water-use-limits-for-data-centres (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
*The [[United States]] [[Food and Drug Administration]] orders manufacturers of [[GLP-1 receptor agonist|GLP-1 medicines]] such as [[semaglutide]] and [[tirzepatide]], originally intended for the treatment of [[type 2 diabetes]] but also [[Anti-obesity medication|commonly used]] for [[weight loss]], to add warnings that use of such drugs may increase the risk of developing [[non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy]], an [[optic nerve]] disorder that can cause permanent [[Visual impairment|blindness]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crwydyde0lp3o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/us-fda-orders-new-eye-risk-warnings-ozempic-zepbound-2026-11-09/ (Reuters)]

**[[El Salvador]] announces a joint [[Armed Forces of El Salvador|military]] operation with the [[Haiti]]an [[Haitian National Police|police]] against the [[400 Mawozo]] gang, in which 20 people are killed and a house linked to its leader, Wilson Joseph, is destroyed.
